/bin/bash -lc "sqlite3 -readonly assets/data/career_path.db <<'SQL'
.headers on
.mode column
WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
  SELECT id, slug, stream_id, parent_id, name, name AS breadcrumb, 0 AS depth
  FROM career_nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id, c.slug, c.stream_id, c.parent_id, c.name,
         tree.breadcrumb || ' > ' || c.name, tree.depth + 1
  FROM career_nodes c JOIN tree ON c.parent_id = tree.id
)
SELECT id, slug, breadcrumb FROM tree
WHERE lower(name) IN ('ba political science','b.sc computer science','bsc computer science','political science','history','sociology','economics','english','hindi','botany','chemistry','zoology','mathematics','physics','computer science')
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%political science%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%computer science%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%b.sc%'
ORDER BY id;
SQL"
